companies.name: MULTIVAC Sepp Haggenmüller SE & Co. KG

records.source_title: Press release 09-24: Press conference at Anuga FoodTec 2024 (MULTIVAC)
records.excerpt: Despite the difficult economic situation, the MULTIVAC Group was able to achieve a stable turnover of around 1.5 billion euros in the previous year. The number of employees increased by around two percent to approx. 7,200 worldwide.
records.population: MULTIVAC Group as a whole
records.does_not_establish: Group turnover and headcount do not show how much, if any, revenue comes from private buyers or very small businesses.

records.source_title: MULTIVAC Sustainability Report 23/24
records.excerpt: We offer our customers wide-ranging solutions for processing and packing food, consumer goods, medical items, and pharmaceutical products.
records.population: MULTIVAC customers by sector
records.does_not_establish: The list of sectors served does not say whether any product is sold to households.

records.source_title: Your future starts now! Gemeinsam voran. (MULTIVAC employer brochure, figures as of 9 May 2023)
records.excerpt: Die MULTIVAC-Gruppe umfasst weltweit 13 Produktionsstandorte und 85 Tochtergesellschaften für Vertrieb und Service in mehr als 165 Ländern auf allen Kontinenten der Welt.
records.population: MULTIVAC Group production and sales/service footprint
records.does_not_establish: Having own sales and service subsidiaries says nothing about retail, e-commerce or consumer distribution capacity.

records.source_title: MULTIVAC Sustainability Report 23/24
records.excerpt: In our Training and Application Centers we tune these packaging and processing solutions to the individual requirements of our customers - from handcrafting businesses through to industrial-scale companies.
records.population: MULTIVAC customers, from craft businesses to industrial firms
records.does_not_establish: It names craft businesses as customers but gives no count or revenue share for them, and does not mention private households.

records.source_title: Pressemitteilung 18-24: MULTIVAC auf der SÜFFA (28.-30.09.2024)
records.excerpt: Das Unternehmen zeigt effiziente Einstiegslösungen für das Verarbeiten und Verpacken von Fleischprodukten, die speziell auf kleine und mittlere Chargen und damit auf die Anforderungen von Handwerk und Mittelstand ausgelegt sind.
records.population: Meat-processing craft businesses and mid-sized firms (butchers' trade fair SÜFFA)
records.does_not_establish: Showing entry-level machines at a trade fair does not show how many craft butchers buy them or at what price.

records.source_title: Pressemitteilung 18-24: MULTIVAC auf der SÜFFA (28.-30.09.2024)
records.excerpt: Zusätzlich wird die Tischkammermaschine C 200 ausgestellt, die für das Vakuumieren von kleinen Produkten geeignet ist und durch ihre Kompaktheit ebenso auf die Anforderungen kleinerer Betriebe zugeschnitten ist.
records.population: Smaller meat-processing businesses; tabletop chamber machine C 200
records.does_not_establish: It describes the smallest machine shown as suited to smaller businesses, not to private households, and gives no price.

records.source_title: MULTIVAC Tabletop chamber machines C 70, C 100, C 200, C 250 (product brochure, hosted by a catering-equipment dealer)
records.excerpt: MULTIVAC tabletop chamber machines can be used very flexibly due to their compact dimensions. This means they are an ideal packaging solution for butchers, cheese dairies, restaurants, hotels, direct sellers and supermarkets as well as for a wide range of consumer goods.
records.population: Users of MULTIVAC tabletop chamber machines: butchers, cheese dairies, restaurants, hotels, direct sellers, supermarkets
records.does_not_establish: The 2014 brochure lists commercial user groups only; it does not show current positioning or any household use.

records.source_title: Pressemitteilung 01-19: Konsumentenpreis für Kammer-Vakuumierer „KüchenInnovation des Jahres® 2019“: MULTIVAC home
records.excerpt: Mehr als 1.000 Berater und Service-Techniker in aller Welt stellen ihr Know-how und ihre Erfahrung in den Dienst des Kunden und sorgen für eine maximale Verfügbarkeit aller installierten MULTIVAC Maschinen.
records.population: MULTIVAC sales advisers and service technicians serving installed machines
records.does_not_establish: A field service network built for installed industrial machines does not show it could serve or reach household buyers.

records.source_title: Pressemitteilung 01-19: Konsumentenpreis für Kammer-Vakuumierer „KüchenInnovation des Jahres® 2019“: MULTIVAC home
records.excerpt: Der Kammer-Vakuumierer wird von MULTIVAC in Deutschland nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards gefertigt.
records.population: MULTIVAC home, a chamber vacuum sealer for households (the release is about a consumer award for it)
records.does_not_establish: The 2019 release shows the household product was made and promoted then; it does not show sales volumes or whether it is still sold.

records.source_title: iF Design Award: MULTIVAC home, vacuum chamber machine (entry lists launch 2016, target group Consumer / User)
records.excerpt: Stainless steel, aluminum and glass are durable materials, easy to clean and perfectly adapt into high-class kitchens. The vacuum pump which is maintenance-free produces the same vacuum level as machines for industrial applications.
records.population: MULTIVAC home chamber vacuum sealer for consumers
records.does_not_establish: An award entry text supplied for the product does not show demand, price acceptance or commercial results.

records.source_title: FoodTechBiz: Packaging that is efficient, automated, digitalised and sustainable (interpack 2026 press conference report)
records.excerpt: Our turnover rose by 5.3 percent to 1.59 billion euros, while our worldwide workforce grew to around 7,800 staff members,” said Christian Traumann. “Against the background of rising energy prices, shortages of personnel and fragile supply chains, we see automation and digital solutions as the crucial drivers of growth for our customers – and for us.“
records.population: MULTIVAC Group, CEO statement on 2025 results and growth drivers
records.does_not_establish: The CEO's view of growth drivers for industrial customers does not rule out a consumer line; it only shows where management says growth comes from.

records.source_title: Wikipedia (de): Multivac Sepp Haggenmüller
records.excerpt: Heute ist Multivac ein multinationales Unternehmen mit 85 Tochtergesellschaften, 16 Produktionsstandorten, Kunden in mehr als 165 Ländern und insgesamt etwa 7.800 Mitarbeitern. Die Exportquote liegt bei 90 Prozent.
records.population: MULTIVAC Group
records.does_not_establish: An export share and headcount say nothing about customer type or any consumer revenue.

records.source_title: testberichte.de: Multivac home, Vakuumiergerät für anspruchsvolle Privatanwender (editorial verdict)
records.excerpt: Der Vakuumierer von Multivac arbeitet nach dem Prinzip der Kammer-Vakuumierer, die im professionellen Bereich Verwendung finden. Das vergleichsweise große und schwere Tischgerät ist dann eine nähere Betrachtung wert, wenn in Ihrer Küche regelmäßig Vakuumier-Gut anfällt und Sie Wert auf hochwertige Küchengeräte legen.
records.population: Private users considering the MULTIVAC home chamber vacuum sealer
records.does_not_establish: An editorial product description is not a performance test and does not show how many households bought the device.

records.source_title: sousvidetools.com (Gastronomy Plus Ltd): Multivac brand page
records.excerpt: Baseline chamber machines are therefore the ideal vacuum packaging solution for butchers´shops, restaurants, hotels, chees dairies, direct marketing companies and farm shops.
records.population: Small food businesses buying Multivac Baseline chamber machines through a specialist online dealer
records.does_not_establish: A dealer listing shows a route to small businesses, not sales volumes or whether private buyers use it.

records.source_title: Stiftung Warentest: Vakuumierer im Test, Vier Geräte sind gut (test 01/2018)
records.excerpt: Caso VC 10 saugt schnell die Luft aus dem Beutel, arbeitet allerdings recht laut. Mit 60 Euro ist das Gerät zudem das preis­werteste im Test. Insgesamt fast gleich­auf ist Steba VK4 für 90 Euro.
records.population: Household vacuum sealers (bar sealers) tested by a consumer-testing organisation
records.does_not_establish: The 2018 test covered six low-cost bar sealers, not chamber machines, so it shows the consumer price point, not demand for a premium chamber device.

records.source_title: Newell Brands: Our brands, FoodSaver
records.excerpt: FoodSaver® is the world’s #1 vacuum sealing system that helps avoid waste by keeping food fresher, longer. For over 30 years, FoodSaver has introduced innovative vacuum sealers, bags, and accessories to help people around the world avoid food waste, enjoy their food at its freshest, and save thousands of dollars each year.
records.population: FoodSaver consumer vacuum sealers (Newell Brands)
records.does_not_establish: The '#1' and savings claims are the brand owner's own and are not independently verified here; FoodSaver's success does not transfer to a machine builder.

records.source_title: Anova Culinary: Anova Precision Chamber Vacuum Sealer (product page)
records.excerpt: Chamber sealers are used by professional chefs due to their ability to reliably achieve an airtight, mess-free seal — especially when it comes to liquids. The Anova Precision™ Chamber Vacuum Sealer brings that technology to your home at a fraction of the cost, with plenty of preset modes to do far more than just sealing.
records.population: Home cooks buying a consumer chamber vacuum sealer
records.does_not_establish: A competitor's marketing claim shows that a home chamber sealer exists, not that it sells well or earns a margin.

records.source_title: Anova Culinary: Anova Precision Chamber Vacuum Sealer, customer review
records.excerpt: This time, I decided to try something new. I had heard of the chamber sealers from hunting buddies but thought they were too pricey for my needs.
records.population: One home user who switched from a suction sealer to a chamber sealer
records.does_not_establish: A single review on the seller's own page is not representative of hunters or home cooks in general.

records.source_title: Landig + Lava: Company history
records.excerpt: Manfred Landig, together with his sons Aaron and Christian Landig, founded the "Lava" brand (Lava = Landig vacuum packing). Thanks to their sophisticated engineering and handy yet robust housing, the products were a hit on the market.
records.population: Lava vacuum sealers, a brand from a firm whose roots are game refrigeration for hunters
records.does_not_establish: The company's own history does not quantify sales or show that hunters are its main vacuum-sealer buyers.

records.source_title: DataHorizzon Research: Household Vacuum Sealing Machines Market (public report summary)
records.excerpt: Chamber vacuum sealers, while representing a smaller market share, are gaining popularity among serious home cooks and culinary enthusiasts who require professional-grade sealing capabilities for sous vide cooking and bulk food processing.
records.population: Household vacuum sealer buyers; chamber versus external sealers
records.does_not_establish: A market-research summary gives no share figure for chamber sealers here and its method is not disclosed.

records.source_title: Food Standards Agency guidance on the safety and shelf-life of vacuum and modified atmosphere packed chilled foods with respect to non-proteolytic Clostridium botulinum (June 2016, hosted by Food Standards Scotland)
records.excerpt: The bacterium Clostridium botulinum is able to grow and produce a harmful toxin in the absence of oxygen. It is important that vacuum-packed chilled foods have the necessary controlling factors or hurdles in place to minimise the risk of growth and toxin production by this organism, throughout the shelf-life of the product.
records.population: Producers and retailers of vacuum-packed chilled foods
records.does_not_establish: The guidance is written for food businesses; it does not regulate household appliances or say how home users handle the risk.

records.source_title: EU Transition Pathways (European Commission content): Food Contact Materials
records.excerpt: Food comes into contact with many materials and articles during its production, processing, storage, preparation and serving, before its eventual consumption. Such materials and articles include food packaging and containers, machinery to process food, and kitchenware and tableware.
records.population: Makers of food packaging, food machinery and kitchenware sold in the EU
records.does_not_establish: It states that the rules cover machinery and kitchenware but does not say what extra compliance cost a consumer product would bring.
